issues.title: Item list
issues.body:
## So that
stewards keep the kit list current without a spreadsheet

## Done when
- A steward can add, rename and retire an item, and a retired item stops appearing in search

## Evidence
automated behaviour check

issues.title: Sign in with a work account
issues.body:
## So that
only the team reaches the calendar

## Done when
- Someone with a company Google account reaches the calendar and someone without one does not

## Evidence
guided manual check

issues.title: Availability calendar
issues.body:
## So that
a steward can see what is free before promising it

## Done when
- A date range shows exactly the items free for every day in it

## Evidence
automated behaviour check

issues.title: Book an item
issues.body:
## So that
two people cannot promise the same camera on the same day

## Done when
- A booking that overlaps an existing loan is refused and names the blocking loan

## Evidence
automated behaviour check

issues.title: Collect and return
issues.body:
## So that
the list reflects what is actually on the shelf

## Done when
- An item marked collected shows as out, and returning it frees the remaining days

## Evidence
automated behaviour check

issues.title: Overdue list
issues.body:
## So that
kit that has not come back gets chased

## Done when
- A steward sees loans past their return date, oldest first

## Evidence
guided manual check

issues.title: Kit grouping
issues.body:
## So that
a whole kit goes out in one booking rather than six

## Done when
- Booking a kit creates one loan per item and a half-available kit shows which parts are free

## Evidence
automated behaviour check

## Not in this piece
Kits that span two sites.

issues.title: Email reminders when a loan is due back
issues.body:
## Left out
The team sits in one room and asking out loud already works.

issues.title: A phone view
issues.body:
## Left out
Left out until someone actually tries to book from a van.

issues.title: Let a steward download the overdue list as a spreadsheet
issues.body:
## So that
a steward can take the list into the Monday meeting without a laptop

## Done when
- A steward gets a file that opens in a spreadsheet, one row per overdue loan

## Evidence
source-backed fact

We do not know whether the spreadsheet library this project already uses can write that format, or whether it only reads it.

issues.title: Make it obvious which items are out right now
issues.body: Stewards keep asking who has what. Something on the main page showing what is out, but I do not know what it should look like.

issues.title: Show the return date on the loan screen where a steward will see it
issues.body:
## So that
a steward notices the return date before confirming, not after

## Done when
- The return date is on the confirm screen and a steward reads it back correctly without being prompted

## Evidence
guided manual check

Nobody can agree where on that screen it should sit. It has to be looked at before anybody can settle it.
